prompt.what: a rose-red layered rock bank with a cluster of hexagonal cyan silicate crystal columns, three loose small crystals, one grey-brown boulder; a tilted federal A-frame sample rack (beige tubes, charcoal caps, orange rings, a hanging charcoal core box with a beige panel); three steel-grey drill cores
prompt.colors: rose-red rock #C7475F (lower terracotta band #C2583F, NOT purple, NOT grey), grey-brown boulder #8C7272, cyan crystal #4FE3D8 with white top highlight #B8F7F2 and an opaque grey core patch #6E7580 on the lower half of each face, beige rack #DCC8B3, neutral charcoal caps and box #535556 (NOT navy), orange stripe #CA7610, steel-grey cores #6A6C6E, one pale cut end #E9B99A. Darker areas are the SAME base colour darkened, never saturated blue or violet

extra.m1_00: ROCK: each tier one flat rose-red tone with ONE soft gradient and a soft light top edge (the rock surface feel of the approved M1 card); NO darkening in the gaps between tiers; the lower band flat terracotta; tiers may differ slightly in value; NO cracks, NO strata texture, NO speckles. CRYSTAL: each prism face flat cyan with one soft gradient toward a lighter top; the top cut face the lightest, near-white; on the LOWER HALF of each visible face ONE opaque, jagged-edged mid-grey ore-core patch (flat grey, crisp edge, like a pebble seen inside the crystal); a thin lighter edge along every prism edge; NO glow, NO transparency, NO dark outline. BOULDER: flat grey-brown with one gradient and one single darker groove line. RACK / CORES: booth rules (beige, neutral charcoal, flat orange, steel grey), cores' cut end flat pale peach.
